name: early-warning-os
description: Project OS for the AI Migration & Population Early-Warning Intelligence Pipeline. Project OS (projects, raw inbox, daily logs, brief, shutdown), Intelligence Brain (corridors, sources, taxonomy, playbooks, historical base) and Alert Engine (six-category scoring with a learned rulebook, alerts, three quality gates with human-in-the-loop, board, feedback). v0.2 learns early-warning rules from past documents and migration figures. Run the setup skill in an empty folder to begin.
